title: Elle
text:
Dr Elle Saber is a statistician working on quantitative methods in biology. She has an interdisciplinary background, beginning her career in economics before shifting her focus to biological data science.
Elle has worked across a range of topics in agriculture and aquaculture. Her PhD explored methods for analysing microbiome data, using a gill microbiome dataset from Atlantic Salmon.
Alongside her research, Elle has taught statistics and R programming, in both classroom and collaborative settings. She values opportunities to collaborate with researchers from different fields and enjoys contributing her skills to diverse projects.




Postdoctoral Research Fellow
ARC Training Centre in Plant Biosecurity
Stone Lab, Research School of Biology
Australian National University




Ph. D. | June 2025
Research School of Finance, Actuarial Studies and Statistics, Australian National University
* Thesis: Resemblance between Microbiomes
